北京.name: 北京

北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy with a real feel of -2℃. Remember to dress warmly to stay cozy!

慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 5℃。有点凉意，出门加件外套吧。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast with a feel of 5℃. It's a bit cool, so grab a jacket when you go out.

上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨绵绵，体感 5℃。带好雨具，注意保暖哦。

深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and feels like 15℃. Enjoy the pleasant weather and have a wonderful day!
